rows.name:
When I reported that my journey was
over, someone came to pick me up,
mo...

rows.label: qst500209_msg0002
rows.name:
Going back means more days of elite
education at Fortis Trade Guild.
That's depressing, mooo.

rows.label: qst500209_msg0003
rows.name:
Right, Foorara is
the heir to Fortis
Trade Guild, mo.

rows.label: qst500209_msg0004
rows.name:
I train hard every day to surpass
Avaritia, the number one Nopon trading
company, mo.

rows.label: qst500209_msg0005
rows.name:
But I'll use the memories of meeting
you all on this journey to keep going,
mo.

rows.label: qst500209_msg0006
rows.name: This is Foorara's thank-you gift, mo!

rows.label: qst500209_msg0008
rows.name:
Take care, everyone, and keep doing
your best for Alst, mo!
